A reconnaissance '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] was flown by the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Zev Senesca/Legends|Zev Senesca]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. The mission was a trap laid by the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]], who had hired [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to ambush the squadron and kill [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who was wanted for destroying the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. The mercenaries' [[Starfighter combat/Legends|airstrike]] failed, leaving two alive. One as killed by [[Kaminoan "super-weapon" project|large creature]]; Skywalker and the other mercenary, [[Lune Oddo Divinian|Div]] were swallowed alive by the creatures and taken to an underground lair. Div, illustrating proficiency with Skywalker's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], saved them both. A [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Tank/Legends|armored column]] was destroyed by more of the creatures, which were [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] experiments. The Rebels left the planet with help from the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. X-7 had to face his master, the ambitious Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]] for his failure. Soresh, not willing to give up his quest to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Skywalker, set more [[Battle of Belazura|schemes]] into motion, culminating in his [[Battle of the Sixela system|death]] months later.

==Prelude==
The [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]], personally trained by ambitious [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]] was given a mission to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] responsible for the torpedo strike which destroyed the Imperial [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. Having been stymied on more than one occasion, X-7 hired several [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to aid him. Luring the hired pilots to his hidden [[Iope|base]], firing on them and killing several. Five survived his test, including [[Lune Oddo Divinian|Div]]. X-7 paid them to take out [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Skywalker at the time was leading [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]], a Rebel Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit. Skywalker led them on a reconnaissance mission to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="RF: Firefight" />

==The battle==
Red Squadron was ambushed by X-7's mercenaries upon arriving at Kamino, but the Rebel pilots outflew the mercenaries and shot them all down. Two survived and crash-landed. Skywalker and his fellow Rebels landed to confront them. One of the surviving mercenaries was eaten by a [[Kaminoan "super-weapon" project|large creature]], the product of a secret biological weapons project. Div and Skywalker were both trapped by another creature, and transported in its air pocket to an underwater lair. Div took Skywalker's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and used it to save them both by killing a creature. The two escaped to the surface and rejoined the squadron.<ref name="RF: Firefight" />

Red Squadron, while trying to rescue Skywalker, met the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Elo Panil]], the one most responsible for the creatures; Panil subsequently died in an Imperial attack. The Rebels were then attacked by Imperial [[Tank/Legends|tanks]], but several of the creatures grabbed the tanks and dragged them underwater. Skywalker and Div then used [[I-7 Howlrunner]]s while [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] took [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170]] trying to escape planet.

[[Zev Senesca/Legends|Zev Senesca]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] escaped prior to Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca, then returned to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to inform [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. She traveled to Kamino in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]], along with eight X-wings, three [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] and a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|blockade runner]], to rescue the rebels still on Kamino, however they had already stolen ships. They escaped the planet, taking Div with them.<ref name="RF: Firefight" />

==Aftermath==
Having failed Soresh once again, X-7 was recalled to [[Belazura]] for reconditioning. Div was sequestered in the Rebel's [[Great Temple/Legends|headquarters]] but refused to cooperate. After mysterious operatives broke him out of [[Prison/Legends|prison]], the Rebels followed the trail to Belazura, where [[Battle of Belazura|X-7 confronted his past]].<ref name="RF: Trapped" /> Following the debacle, Soresh was exiled and left for the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], eventually setting in a plan which [[Battle of the Sixela system|resulted]] in his death.<ref name="Rebel Force: Uprising">''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This mission appears in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2009]] book ''[[Rebel Force: Firefight]]''. Div originally played a role in ''[[Star Wars: The Last of the Jedi]]'' series.
